title: chrysanthemum trichophyllum
intro: Chrysanthemum trichophyllum, commonly known as the White Chrysanthemum, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum trichophyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-boosting effects. By incorporating this plant into herbal remedies, individuals may experience improved immune function and reduced inflammation, promoting overall well-being and health.
